name: @lechuza/desktop
description: Lechuza: on-device dictation and meeting transcripts for macOS.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist-electron dist-renderer && bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist-electron/main.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist-electron/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && cp -R ../web/dist dist-renderer

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lechuza records your microphone during meetings, so you can replay and read them. Audio never leaves this Mac.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Lechuza records the call's audio, the other side of your meetings, so you can replay and read them. Audio never leaves this Mac.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Lechuza saves each meeting as plain files in Documents → Lechuza → Meetings.

author: Jorge Mena
